name: Bear School
source:
Bear School is a silly visual novel where you can attend a school full of talking bears - and maybe find the love of your life! Give it a try, life is short dude. Go date a bear. Live the good life.

[From [url=https://youtu.be/dtGTJeyJHHo]YouTube[/url]]
translation:
《熊学校》是一部愚蠢的视觉小说，你可以在一所充满会说话的熊的学校里上学 - 也许还能找到你一生的挚爱！尝试一下吧，人生苦短。去和熊约会吧。过上美好的生活。

[来自[url=https://youtu.be/dtGTJeyJHHo]YouTube[/url]]
